acceptance: A test fails when a registered verb has no top-level help entry
Every verb exits 0 and prints its subverbs on --help (table test over the registry)
fix: Render top-level help from the registry, grouped by the command map of docs/reference/evolve-commands.md, so no verb can be absent. Make --help and -h print usage and exit 0 for every verb.
summary: 45 of 127 registered verbs have no entry in `evolve --help`, including agent, inbox, integration, events, signals, landing, auth, commit-gate, cli-routing, sync-main, tokens and stage. Six verbs answer --help with 'unknown subcommand', and 12 exit non-zero on --help. Policy rules CD-30 and related in docs/conventions/cli-design.md.
title: evolve --help lists every registered verb, grouped, and every verb answers --help
